comment: The exports of Windows' kernel-mode files. A build of source 'symbol' is an x64 file of one Windows version from the Microsoft symbol server (keys from Winbindex); one of source 'wdk' is what that WDK's import libraries say the file exports, for its arch (the only source for x86). Each export lists the indexes of the builds that have it; '#n' is an export by ordinal n with no name. `absent` names the x64 Windows versions with no build of the file in Winbindex. `indexSha256` is the hash Winbindex gives a build whose key the symbol server answers with another build's file. `symbols` holds the x86 decorated symbol of each export the WDK's libraries name: '@Name@n' is __fastcall, '_Name@n' __stdcall, n the bytes of the arguments.
